summary: This was a clean, small loss on a valid idea, and you stopped after it even though you felt revenge and FOMO. That part is real progress. The idea was right: bearish SMT with ES at the highs, NQ above PDH while ES stayed under it, and a short into the 4h unfilled gap, and price did run to your target. Two things lost you the trade, though. Your stop was at ~27,803, inside the 15min rejection block and under the NYAM high (~27,840), so the spike to ~27,836 took you out before the move. You also entered around 9:47 AM at ~27,746.75, which is below the 0.618 and not at the .786 you wrote, and that's before the consolidation your pre-market said you needed. On the process side, I couldn't find a Morning Check-in in your pair channel today (SYNDICATOR told you to file /checkin at 10:31 AM), but your EOD card still says 'Rules Followed: Yes'.
trade: Short · NY-AM (~9:47 AM ET) · XFA · Loss · entry ~27,746.75 · stop ~27,803.00 (under NYAM.H ~27,840, inside the 15min rejection block) · target ~27,465 (4h unfill / daily open, about 5R) · stopped by the spike to ~27,836 before 9:51 AM, then price ran to target without you. Levels are read off the position tool's price-axis labels.
rule: Friday: file the Morning Check-in with your risk screenshot before 9:30 AM, or no trade. On a short, the stop goes above the actual protected high (today that was NYAM.H), not just the displacement candle. If that makes the stop too wide for your risk, size down or skip.

screenshots.label: Execution 1 · 1min NQ / ES (9:51 AM)
screenshots.feedback: The position tool shows entry 27,746.75 and stop 27,803.00 on the price axis, with the target box reaching down to ~27,465. Your entry is below the 0.618 (~27,755) and nowhere near the .786 (~27,788) in your notes, so you took a shallower fill than planned. The stop sits in the middle of the red 15min rejection block and ~37 points under NYAM.H. By 9:51 price was already at 27,823 after wicking to ~27,836, so the stop was swept and the high still held. A stop above ~27,845 (top of the block / NYAM.H) would have survived that. ES on the left makes a lower high under its NYAM.H, which is the SMT you traded, and that read was correct.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 1 · 4h NQ / ES (9:26 AM)
screenshots.feedback: NQ pushes above PD-H and up into the trendline from the November high, while ES is still under its own PD-H. That's a clean HTF bearish SMT and backs up 'want to see us dump today'.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 2 · 4h ES / Daily NQ (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: The daily shows NQ bouncing hard off the November low into PD-H, still inside a larger bear leg. That matches AB's 'HTF bear market, expect a reversal' note. The bias was fine.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 3 · 4h NQ / ES (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: Same 4h picture, with the 4h unfilled range below PD-EQ, which is the DOL you wrote. The draw was obvious and it got hit.

screenshots.label: TimeFrame 4 · 1h NQ / ES (9:27 AM)
screenshots.feedback: The 1h shows NQ stretched above PD-H with a small rejection. Your pre-market called for consolidation up here before shorting. The 9:47 entry came off the first push, not a consolidation, which is the hesitation you then carried into the re-entry.

good: You took one loss and locked out. You wrote 'I did feel lots of emotions an revenge/fomo' and still didn't chase. That's the discipline that keeps the XFA alive after the payout.
The bias and the draw were right: HTF bearish SMT vs ES, short into the 4h unfill, and price reached the target. Your read is getting good.
Your EOD card was filed at 11:26 AM with the screenshot, and 'stop caring about the PNL or getting another payout' is the right lesson to take from today.
fix: Stop placement: 27,803 was under NYAM.H (~27,840) and inside the rejection block, so it wasn't protected. 'The high that made the displacement' isn't the same as the high that has to hold for the idea to be wrong.

Entry vs plan: the pre-market said you needed consolidation before shorting, and the Notion entry says OTE .786, but the fill was ~27,746.75 below the 0.618 at about 9:47 AM. In the journal channel you wrote 'Never got the entry i wanted', so be honest that this was a forced entry.

No Morning Check-in that I could find in pair-dezukai-1bibz today. The first message was yours at 10:31 AM, and SYNDICATOR replied 'file the check-in with /checkin first'. Even so, the EOD card says 'Rules Followed: Yes'.
'A bit annoyed after seeing my target fully hit i wouldve hit 1.2k' is the PNL focus you said you want to drop. Judge the trade by where the stop was, not by the dollars you missed.

questions.q: You wrote 'i need to see consolidation before shorting' in pre-market, then shorted around 9:47 off the first push and said 'Never got the entry i wanted'. What made you take it anyway instead of waiting for the consolidation you planned?
Your stop was 27,803 and the spike topped around 27,836, under NYAM.H. If the stop had to be above NYAM.H, would the trade still fit your risk, and if it didn't, should it have been a trade at all?
There was no Morning Check-in today, but the EOD card says 'Rules Followed: Yes'. Is the check-in one of your rules or not, and what happened this morning?
You skipped the re-entry because it didn't consolidate, but you took the first entry without consolidation. Which of those two decisions actually followed your plan?
